Vande Bharat Train Travels with Faulty Brakes, Passengers Fined

A Vande Bharat train reportedly traveled 463 kilometers with faulty brakes, despite railway staff allegedly ignoring warnings. In a separate incident, 12 individuals who boarded a Vande Bharat train to see off relatives found themselves traveling 140 kilometers before being fined a total of Rs 36,000 after the automatic doors closed, trapping them inside.
